review_scope: Current PR18 embodiment regression review, including changed D111 prose, exact availability and endpoint joins, their general ordering implication, inherited EC-D6 limits, and all eleven retained contracts. This supersedes the erroneous unchanged-source re-attestation. AR-1 through AR-11 remain local construction findings, not complete canonical parity claims; AR-12 through AR-15 state the additional limits and corrections. findings.resolution: Candidate obtainment is definitionally tied to EmbodiedRecurrentStructure and locked by the EC-D6 equivalence theorem.
Free coordination, registration, affection, and representational-efficacy predicates were replaced by exact membership, endpoint, feed, and equality joins.
Each formalized anti-entailment now negates the canonical target structure at the declared shared indices; proxy false predicates were removed.
Body is a state-indexed Relation without a separate identity criterion; Entity supplies Boundary, Interior, Persistence, and identity.
Both recurrent Transformation families and the perspective-selection join are indexed through the same Body, Entity, Direction, and feeding relation.
Action and complete Control plus Attribution and Designation reverse anti-entailments are binding prose explicitly marked outside the current reduct instead of receiving proxy countermodels.
Evaluation status and human promotion disposition are recorded independently, preserving incomplete model evaluation without treating it as a release veto or pass.
Schema-v2 manifests, exact Lean promotion contracts, a semantic-field ledger, and exact-source review hashes now turn the relevant review obligations into CI failures.

Every dependency of a theorem-backed statement now has an exact disposition; checked symbols derive from that complete ledger, required_symbols is forbidden, and boundary-bearing projections cannot use the fully proved status.

Embodied Perspective now contains explicit PerspectivePerception, PerspectiveMemory, and PerspectiveModel objects joined to internal States, Persistence, Contributions, Representations, Transformations, later States, and Boundary Constraints.

Bodily Organization requires pairwise distinct recurring Transformations for every pair of distinct named Organs, and Body States form an ordered nonempty subsequence of Entity Persistence rather than equaling the complete history.

D111 no longer prescribes the rejected alternative as an actual contrast-path endpoint. Canonical rejection is a contrasting possibility within the represented condition, not a prior occurrence. The EC-D5 dossier matches that reading, its ledger now accounts for exact availability, and the Lean record is explicitly a restricted temporal witness. The obsolete governsEmbodiment signature is removed.

restrictedSelectionOrdersOutputs proves that the retained InternalActivitySelection forces rejected.output before selected.output. The asymmetric Direction excludes simultaneous outputs and exchanging the same pair's roles; Body membership also requires actual occurrences. EC-D5 is therefore not a characterization of canonical contrast-only selection. EC-D6 inherits the restriction. Shared represented-condition completeness and semantic continuation/inhibition/revision are not established by the supplied fields or mode tag.

availabilityExactlyOptions proves exact membership in a declared list, not practical feasibility or computational constructivity. A classical noncomputable Specification can meet the record. Availability is not joined to the perspective's complete advertised inventory. The binding prose no longer promises constructivity and the dossier states these limits.

Exact-source review enforcement now includes every formal_evidence file, with an omission/drift regression. Both reviews attest the committed current implementation and enumerate only current contracts. The 48-job build and finite executable pass; the integrated audit checks 2549 project theorems with zero declared project axioms and only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound dependencies.
